text:
Midweek: the market light is still RED (VIX 31). Chips fell 7% this week after giving back Monday's Huang rally; renewed congressional scrutiny and rising rate-hike expectations weighed on them. Staples and consumer stocks are flat to slightly up.
AMD is -18% this week, about 12 points worse than the market. A resale filing for about 337M shares tied to OpenAI and Meta warrants is adding pressure; AMD receives no proceeds. Its business story is intact, and it is well above the 355.92 disaster stop.
NVDA is flat this week after the reinstatement swing.
The SNOW and CRWD sells still stand. The CRWD-Zscaler all-stock deal (announced Monday) adds dilution and regulatory risk.
US markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving, and Friday is a half day.

cautions.why: Share resale filing (warrant holders) is weighing on the stock; it is down 25% vs entry.
